confirmation_policy: All Train years are previously studied development data. No untouched OOS claim. Historical Valid already read in prior research but never accessed in this experiment.

feature_definitions.size: -log(raw Close * latest positive disclosed issued shares); no ScaleCategory fallback
feature_definitions.illiquidity: abs(organizer raw_return)/positive raw TurnoverValue; 60 exchange-date trailing mean, min_periods=40; absent stock dates explicitly missing
value: Equity / positive shares / positive raw Close
feature_definitions.normalization: Every raw feature: per-date 1%/99% winsorization, daily median imputation then 0, sample-std z-score, zero if scale=0. Within-block fixed arithmetic mean; each block global same-date sample-std z-score without a second winsorization. Sum 3 equally weighted blocks.
feature_definitions.pit: Fins Date is disclosed date only; available at 23:59:59 JST that date. Signal time same day 23:59:59 JST. Per-field previous nonmissing disclosed value; backward as-of only. Listed Sector17Code exact Date/Code join. No retrospectively adjusted price level; shares/EPS never back-adjusted for corporate actions.
feature_definitions.sector: Quality/Value raw feature winsorization, median and z-score within same-date PIT Sector17Code if >=20 finite observations; otherwise entire transform falls back to global same-date. Block scale remains global.
feature_definitions.revision: Latest finite disclosed ForecastEPS minus previous finite disclosed ForecastEPS divided by signal-date raw Close; previous includes unchanged finite disclosure, does not skip equal values; missing new disclosure does not create event. Normalize globally with same 1%/99% winsor/median/z; add as equal fourth block. Extends SECTOR if it passes Phase3 gate, else BASE if it passes; deterministic parent priority.

model: Fixed additive economic blocks; no training, no Momentum, no learned weights, no smoothing or turnover overlays.
selection_rule: Next-stage research candidate only if pooled and ex-2016 net positive, >=4/5 full-year net positive, Net SR exceeds BOTH fixed controls in >=4/5 full years and pooled, both pooled Long/Short net positive, pooled RankIC and Q monotonicity positive, paired bootstrap delta NetSR lower 95% bound >0 against both controls. If multiple pass: prioritize positive-fold count then worst full-year NetSR, fewer blocks on tie. Turnover .03/day design aim, not adoption threshold. Otherwise reject fixed operationalization; no rescue trials.

bootstrap.method: paired circular moving-block, Net Sharpe difference
